en.general: Humans are simultaneously deeply similar and richly diverse. Students learn to hold both poles without collapsing diversity into a single norm or treating cultures as wholly incommensurable.

extensions.oe:fullStatement: CROSS-CUTTING THEME 2 -- Variation and Universals: Humans are simultaneously deeply similar (shared biology, universal cognitive capacities, common needs) and richly diverse (cultural practices, languages, social structures, ecological adaptations). Students learn to hold both poles.
extensions.oe:sensitiveTopicNote: Always present cultural diversity as multiple adaptive solutions to shared human challenges, not as stages of development or degrees of advancement.

oe:strandActivation.activationNote: Primary strand -- cross-cultural behavioral ecology and cooperative diversity
Primary strand -- WEIRD bias critique; cross-cultural cognitive development
Language and folklore diversity alongside linguistic universals
Genetic population structure and diversity as biological backdrop to cultural diversity
